dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent closed-ring and open C-shaped geometries are visible across the dorsal midsection. These structures exhibit high-contrast dark perimeters approximately 3-8 pixels wide, with a sharp gradient transition into lighter-toned, high-luminosity interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the lower lateral margins and trailing towards the posterior, appearing as asymmetrical, amorphous shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A distinct triangular spatial relationship is formed by the centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the upper-mid dorsal region. Secondary linear alignments of smaller annuli extend along the longitudinal axis towards the posterior section.
